verdict.rationale: Docs claim 'resilient partitioning logic and robust visibility' and job tracking that lets you 'inspect any files that failed during processing,' implying some built-in reliability at scale, but there is no explicit evidence of handling thousand-page documents or multi-gigabyte files, no timeout limits documented, and no benchmarks or case studies addressing silent truncation. Missing for 10: documented file-size/page limits, explicit large-document benchmarks, evidence of timeout handling, and independent confirmation of reliability at scale.
